title: Senior Manager, Global Advanced Manufacturing Engineering

cond_0001.intro:
We are looking for a Senior Manager of Global Advanced Manufacturing Engineering to join our team as a subject matter expert in Sheet Metal fabrication. Your primary responsibility will be to leverage your expertise in Sheet Metal Fabrication end-to-end process, developing global strategy, metal fabrication technology assessment, equipment recommendations, and enhancing internal sheet metal production processes. Collaborating with cross-functional teams, you will lead initiatives to optimize manufacturing workflows, ensuring efficiency, precision, and quality in every aspect of sheet metal fabrication.
Your role will involve staying current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices to continuously innovate and improve metal fabrication capabilities. You will also contribute to the development and implementation of standardized procedures, fostering a culture of excellence and reliability in metal fabrication production across global operations. Beyond technical work, you will collaborate with various stakeholders, offering insights and recommendations to enhance product designs, troubleshoot manufacturing challenges, and contribute to the continuous improvement of sheet metal capabilities.
